name: @mayarin/subgraph
description: Subgraph over PaymentRouter settlements, per chain

scripts.build:base-sepolia: bun run codegen && graph build --network base-sepolia
scripts.build:arc-testnet: bun run codegen && graph build --network arc-testnet
scripts.deploy:base-sepolia: bun run codegen && graph deploy mayarin-base-sepolia --node https://api.studio.thegraph.com/deploy/ --network base-sepolia
scripts.deploy:arc-testnet: bun run codegen && graph deploy mayarin-arc-testnet --node https://api.studio.thegraph.com/deploy/ --network arc-testnet
